vehicle: 2026 Porsche 911 Turbo S Cabriolet · Gentian Blue Metallic
measurementScope: The 62 matched views show the production GLB at the native dimensions of each original. The 52 exterior silhouette measurements compare the previous and current meshes through identical cameras on a 1280 × 720 mask grid. Distances are scaled to a 3840 px width. Each status refers to the visible features described in its note.

rearGlass.metric: Symmetric nearest perimeter distance and filled outer pane IoU, in the saved camera, against the studio photograph. Masks refined from hand-traced contours. Includes the ceramic border.

rearCornerOutlets.method: Manual landmark marks on four Porsche photographs. Projected matching points on the rebuilt outer duct lip through the saved model cameras. Left and right ducts share the mirrored geometry.

paintResponseStudy.scope: Isolated viewer paint change against the 52 matched exterior photographs, with the previous mesh and all cameras frozen for both renders. Reported errors cover visible blue-painted panel interiors and adjacent specular reflections, in 8-bit sRGB levels, at 1024 x 576. Held-out means exclude these camera directions from the light-volume fit.
